items.title: Coffee Prices Are High. Why Ground Coffee Is Holding Up Better Than K-Cups.
items.summary: FEATURE  Coffee drinkers aren’t giving up their daily cup of joe as bean prices rise, but they are leaning toward options that offer better value. That shift is producing sharply different results for companies that sell ground coffee, pods, and made-to-order drinks.
